description: This file is a shell script used for configuring and managing wireless interfaces, hostapd, network settings, and related services on a router or network device. It includes functions to restart hostapd, modify configurations, update network interfaces, and start network services.

methods.name: Restart_Hostapd
methods.description: Stops wireless interface, kills hostapd, and restarts wireless interfaces with specified configs.

methods.name: Restart_Hostapd_5G
methods.description: Reloads kernel modules rtl8812au and 88x2bu, then restarts hostapd for 5G interface.

methods.name: Hostapd_Restart
methods.description: Kills existing hostapd instances and restarts the hostapd service on wlan0 interface.
